# Overview

Workplace absenteeism is time taken off of work due factors such as illness.

 
# Data Description and Processing

The dataset that will be used in this project is from the University of California Irvine Machine Learning Repository [1].
The dataset contains 19 columns and 740 rows. 


```{R}

absence.df = read.csv("Absenteeism_at_work.csv")



absence.df$Reason.for.absence = factor(absence.df$Reason.for.absence)
absence.df$Day.of.the.week = factor (absence.df$Day.of.the.week)
absence.df$Seasons = factor(absence.df$Seasons)
absence.df$Disciplinary.failure = factor(absence.df$Disciplinary.failure)
absence.df$Education = factor(absence.df$Education)
absence.df$Social.drinker = factor(absence.df$Social.drinker)
absence.df$Social.smoker = factor(absence.df$Social.smoker)


```

We list the relevant columns below. Note that we choose to not include the first column, as that is the Individual identification (ID) number of the person that was absent. 

##2. Reason for absence (ICD).
Absences attested by the International Code of Diseases (ICD) stratified into 21 categories (I to XXI) as follows:

1. Certain infectious and parasitic diseases  
2. Neoplasms  
3. Diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs and certain disorders involving the immune mechanism  
4. Endocrine, nutritional and metabolic diseases  
5 Mental and behavioural disorders  
6. Diseases of the nervous system  
7. Diseases of the eye and adnexa  
8. Diseases of the ear and mastoid process  
9. Diseases of the circulatory system  
10. Diseases of the respiratory system  
11. Diseases of the digestive system  
12. Diseases of the skin and subcutaneous tissue  
13. Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue  
14. Diseases of the genitourinary system  
15. Pregnancy, childbirth and the puerperium  
16. Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period  
17. Congenital malformations, deformations and chromosomal abnormalities  
18. Symptoms, signs and abnormal clinical and laboratory findings, not elsewhere classified  
19. Injury, poisoning and certain other consequences of external causes  
20. External causes of morbidity and mortality  
21. Factors influencing health status and contact with health services.
22. Patient follow-up
23. Medical consultation 
24. Blood donation 
25. Laboratory examination 
26. Unjustified absence 
27. Physiotherapy 
28. Dental consultation 

3. Month of absence
4. Day of the week (Monday (2), Tuesday (3), Wednesday (4), Thursday (5), Friday (6))
5. Seasons (summer (1), autumn (2), winter (3), spring (4))
6. Transportation expense
7. Distance from Residence to Work (kilometers)
8. Service time
9. Age
10. Work load Average/day 
11. Hit target
12. Disciplinary failure (yes=1; no=0)
13. Education (high school (1), graduate (2), postgraduate (3), master and doctor (4))
14. Son (number of children)
15. Social drinker (yes=1; no=0)
16. Social smoker (yes=1; no=0)
17. Pet (number of pet)
18. Weight (kg)
19. Height 
20. Body mass index
21. Absenteeism time in hours (target)

# Modeling 

```{r, include=FALSE}
#Modeling for all ten predictors



absent.lm <- lm(Absenteeism.time.in.hours ~ Reason.for.absence +	Month.of.absence + Day.of.the.week + Seasons +	Transportation.expense	+ Distance.from.Residence.to.Work +	Service.time	+ Age + Work.load.Average.day +	Hit.target	+ Disciplinary.failure	+ Education +	Son	+ Social.drinker +	Social.smoker +	Pet + 	Weight	+ Height	+Body.mass.index,
  data = absence.df
)
model.summary <- summary(absent.lm)

absent.step <- step(absent.lm, trace = 0)

model2.summary <- summary(absent.step)
```

## Hypothesis

## Model 1:
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.pos = 'H', out.width = "50%"}
#Extracting StdError and P-values
coefficients <- model.summary$coefficients
coef.tbl <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rownames(coefficients),
  Coefficient = coefficients[, "Estimate"],
  StandardError = coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
  PValue = coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
  row.names = NULL
)
kable(
  coef.tbl,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("Predictor", "Coefficient", "Standard Error", "P-value"),
  caption = "Model 1 Fit Regression Coefficients & Significance for all Predictors")
```




```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.pos = 'H', out.width = "50%"}
#Overall fit
f.stat <- model.summary$fstatistic


fit.tbl <- data.frame(
  Measure = c(
    "R-squared (%)",
    "Adjusted R-squared (%)",
    "F-statistic",
    "Model p-value"
  ),
  Value = c(
    round(100 * model.summary$r.squared, 2),
    round(100 * model.summary$adj.r.squared, 2),
    round(f.stat[1], 2),
    "<0.01" #actual value is much lower than 0.01
  )
)

kable(
  fit.tbl,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Model 1 Overall Regression Model Fit Table"
)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.pos = 'H', out.width = "50%"}
model.vif <- vif(coupon.lm)

vif.tbl <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rownames(model.vif),
  VIF = model.vif[, "GVIF"],
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  vif.tbl,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Predictor", "VIF"),
  caption = "Model 1 Multicollinearity Assessment Table"
)
```
